notes: SHIPS AS THE IDENTITY, AND calibrated IS false. This file is a placeholder with the
right shape and no fitted content, because no calibration data exists yet.
A fabricated curve would be a lie with a probability attached to it: the surveyor
reading '87% confident' has no way to know it means '87 arbitrary units'. So the raw
score passes through unchanged, ScoreResult.calibrated is false, it rides on the wire,
and the UI renders confidence as an ordinal score rather than a probability.
Calibration is earned from the ground-truth dataset that manual GCP surveying
produces -- see docs/architecture/SCOPE.md section 2, which records that generating
exactly that dataset is one reason manual mode is the correct thing to build first.
To fit this properly: collect (feature_vector, was_correct) pairs from real jobs,
fit Platt or isotonic offline, set method/params/fitted_on/n_samples, and set
calibrated to true in the SAME commit. ScoreResult.feature_vector is persisted on
every result precisely so this can be done without re-running any CV.
